verdict.rationale: The evidence documents dynamic transactional templates with multiple in-platform versions. It never mentions a first-party documented email-as-code framework such as React Email or MJML, or any workflow for keeping templates in version control. In-app template versioning is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author emails as code — React Email, MJML, or an equivalent maintained framework the vendor documents first-party — and keep templates in version control
